params.message:
The team's assistant is told up front that a source link brings its text

Since gentells-pipeline #502, source_links and source_keep answer with what Gentells read
from each page, and a note not to open the publisher's page. That note arrives with the
answer. An assistant in the Claude app that is asked for a text with its sources opens
the publishers' pages at the same moment it asks for the links, and the app shows those
pages' addresses beside the text: the chips came back.

The server's instructions and both tools' descriptions now say it before the first call:
call source_links first, do not open the publishers' pages, not even at the same time,
and write from the read that comes with each link.

Portal: Een assistent die met Gentells-bronnen schrijft, weet vooraf dat hij de pagina's van de uitgevers niet moet openen.
